mapper.sql: select asset_id, asset_no, asset_name, dept_id, user_id, status, stock from biz_asset
mapper.select: select asset_id, asset_no, asset_name, dept_id, user_id, status, stock from biz_asset where status = '1' order by asset_id desc limit #{limit}
mapper.insert: insert into biz_asset (asset_no, asset_name, dept_id, user_id, status, stock) values (#{assetNo}, #{assetName}, #{deptId}, #{userId}, #{status}, #{stock})
